title: Organic Growth Strategist (B2B SaaS, Remote - EU/UK)
description:
SaaStorm is a fully remote organic growth agency for B2B SaaS, headquartered in London with a team spread across Europe. Since founding in 2024, we've grown to work with SaaS companies from pre-seed through Series C, and we're approaching €1.5M ARR.
 What makes us different is the bet we've made: search is changing, and the companies that win the next five years will be the ones cited by LLMs, not just ranked by Google. We've built our delivery model around that thesis, combining traditional organic growth with AEO/LLM visibility work, and we report on pipeline impact rather than vanity metrics.
 We run senior-led delivery. That means no handoffs to junior teams after the pitch, and it means everyone here owns real client outcomes from day one. We're small, remote, and we like it that way.
 Tasks
 Own end-to-end organic growth for 3-4 B2B SaaS clients
 Build and run SEO + content roadmaps that drive pipeline, sign-ups, revenue
 Turn strategy into action with our writers, linkbuilders, design, and dev (no “strategy theatre”)
 Run SEO / LLMO / GEO experiments (AI Overviews, ChatGPT/Perplexity visibility, query capture, content engineering)
 Monitor and report performance across traditional search + AI platforms (and translate it into decisions)
 What we care about:
 Impact: pipeline, sign-ups, revenue
 Enjoyment: you like the work + the people you do it with
 Flexibility: async where possible, trust by default, no micromanagement
 Requirements
 Please, only apply if you're based in the EU/UK.
 Own end-to-end organic growth for 2–4 B2B SaaS clients.
 Build and execute SEO + content roadmaps that drive pipeline, sign-ups, and revenue.
 Translate strategy into delivery, collaborating closely with writers, link builders, design, and development.
 Plan and run SEO / LLMO / GEO experiments (e.g., AI Overviews, ChatGPT/Perplexity visibility, query capture, content engineering).
 Track, analyse, and report performance across traditional search and AI platforms - and turn ins…

title: Senior Business Development & Partnerships Manager (m/f/x)
description:
Your Mission About the role
At ubitricity, we are helping local authorities deliver accessible, reliable and scalable public EV charging infrastructure across the UK.
We are looking for a  Senior Business Development & Partnership Manager who is proactive, hands-on and commercially minded. As a sales/ business development role, you will own the sales and tender pipeline by identifying opportunities, turn them into concrete actions and help shape future growth with local authorities, public-sector stakeholders, consultants and strategic partners.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys relationship management with public-sector stakeholders, understands how to approach them professionally and knows how to inform, engage and activate them in the right way. You will play a key role in strengthening existing client relationships, building new client relationships, and developing future opportunities and positioning ubitricity as a trusted long-term partner in the UK EV charging market.
 Key Responsibilities
 Client Relationship Management
 Build and maintain strong relationships with local authorities, public-sector clients, consultants and strategic partners. Act as a trusted point of contact across active and future EV charging infrastructure projects. Understand client priorities, local transport plans, procurement timelines and EV charging ambitions. Develop stakeholder engagement plans and account plans for key clients and future opportunities. Prepare, structure and follow up on client meetings, workshops and relationship reviews.
 Partnership Development & Opportunity Shaping
 Identify and actively pursue opportunities and collaborations including direct upsells, contract extensions, brownfield opportunities and upcoming tender opportunities. Support early engagement around upcoming EV charging opportunities, including LEVI-funded programmes. title: Director of Engineering
description:
Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.
 We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.
 We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.
 In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.
 The role You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between.
 Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization.
 We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role.
 What you'll do
 Directly manage and grow the engineering team, including building out its management layer.

title: Senior Google Ads Manager (m/w/d) in Münster
description:
vintrica Mobility betreibt eine der größten digitalen Mobility-Plattformen Europas. Über unser Online-Portal und unsere App erledigen Autofahrer alles, was rund um die Fahrt anfällt: digitale Services für unterwegs, wie z. B. die Bezahlung der Pkw-Maut für Autobahnen im europäischen Ausland per App, Pannenhilfe und Assistance auf der Reise sowie digitale Services für die Autofahrt ins Ausland. Ein Ökosystem, das Millionen Autofahrer aus ganz Europa jedes Jahr auf ihrer Reise nutzen.
 Für unser Marketing-Team heißt das: echte Volumina, saisonale Peaks, internationale Kampagnenstrukturen und ein Google Ads Konto, in dem jede Optimierung sofort messbar wird. Wenn du Performance Marketing nicht als Klick-Verwaltung, sondern als Steuerungsinstrument verstehst, findest du bei uns eine der spannendsten Spielwiesen im deutschen Mid-Market.
 Arbeitsort: Münster
 Aufgaben
 Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für unsere bestehenden Google Ads Kampagnen und entwickelst sie strategisch weiter. Du bist nicht nur die ausführende Hand, sondern der Kopf hinter unserem Paid-Wachstum. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Google Ads aber Microsoft Ads und Meta gehören ebenfalls in deinen Verantwortungsbereich.
 Was dich erwartet:
 Ownership über ein signifikantes Budget: Du steuerst unsere Search-Kampagnen über mehrere europäische Märkte hinweg. Von der Struktur über Gebotsstrategien bis zur täglichen Aussteuerung.
 Skalierung statt Verwaltung: Du identifizierst ungenutztes Potenzial, erschließt neue Märkte und Keyword-Cluster und baust Kampagnen von Grund auf neu, wo es sinnvoll ist.
 Datengetriebene Steuerung: Du arbeitest entlang klarer KPIs (ROAS, CPA, Deckungsbeitrag) und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Analysen, nicht Bauchgefühl.
 Testing-Kultur: Du planst und bewertest A/B-Tests auf Anzeigen- und Gebotsebene und leitest daraus belastbare Learnings ab.
